newsitem.title: UK: NatWest says S African link "pure rumour".
newsitem.headline: NatWest says S African link "pure rumour".

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc said on Thursday that reports it was set to buy a stake in South African financial services group Board of Executors were "pure rumour".
A spokeswoman for NatWest Markets, the British bank's investment banking unit, said, "Normally we don't comment on rumours, but this one is a pure rumour."
BOE, which offers asset management and investment services to private and corporate clients, announced on Wednesday that it was in unspecified negotiations which could affect its share price.
BOE and NatWest already have a joint venture which offers stockbroking and corporate finance services. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
